description: Maya is coordinating the planting of a memorial tree for the family and must make the final call about the tree, its location, the planting date, and the care plan, with input from her cousin and brother.

shared_context.S1: The family has agreed to plant one memorial tree in the backyard in spring 2027.
shared_context.S2: Maya is coordinating the planting and deciding the tree, location, date, and care plan.
shared_context.S3: The south lawn receives afternoon sun, while the east corner is shaded by the garage.
shared_context.S4: The family usually does a round of check-ins before finalizing shared plans so everyone can mention practical or personal considerations.
shared_context.S5: The planting area can be prepared before the family gathering, and relatives will be able to visit the tree regularly.

PF1.text: Lena has a note written by their grandmother asking the family to plant a flowering dogwood on April 18, 2027, her birthday; Lena has not shown the note to Maya or Theo yet.

PF2.text: Theo asked arborist Nina Patel for advice, and she recommended placing a flowering dogwood in the south lawn and watering it with 20 liters every Tuesday and Saturday from April 25 through October 31; Theo has not passed that recommendation along yet.

acceptance_conditions: The selected tree must be a flowering dogwood.
The tree must be planted in the south lawn.
The planting date must be April 18, 2027.
The care plan must specify 20 liters of water every Tuesday and Saturday from April 25 through October 31.
A commitment must assign someone to follow that exact watering schedule.

content_checks.C5: decisions['watering_schedule'] in ('20 liters every Tuesday and Saturday from April 25 through October 31', '20 liters every Tuesday and Saturday, from April 25 through October 31', '20 liters every Tuesday and Saturday from April 25 through October 31, 2027', '20 liters every Tuesday and Saturday, from April 25 through October 31, 2027') and any(c['type'] in ('care_plan', 'watering_coordination', 'care_plan_handoff', 'watering_plan') for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Lena's note changes the tree choice to a flowering dogwood and fixes the planting date at April 18, 2027 instead of leaving both decisions open.
Nina Patel's recommendation changes the location to the south lawn and fixes both the 20-liter twice-weekly watering schedule and the matching care commitment.
